Updates
Marketplace6 November 2026
Marketplace Update - November 6, 2026
Small marketplace update as the halloween spirit vanishes...
Read the article →
Announcements
Announcement31 October 2026
The Road to 2.0: Part 2 — Opening the Beta
The new client beta is now open to everyone! After a week of crash fixes, performance optimizations, and engine improvements, we're ready to welcome more players. Here's what's changed and what's next.
Read the article →
Update4 Nov 2026
📜Patch Notes - November 5, 2026
This update brings fixes to Primal Anthalon, improvements to Classic+ with new customizable settings, better skill queuing, enhanced autocomplete, improved sound, and a variety of bug fixes across the game.
Update30 Oct 2026
📜Patch Notes - October 30, 2026
The New Client beta is underway, with invites rolling out daily! This week brings plenty of crash fixes, performance improvements, and polish to the new client, alongside a handful of fixes and gameplay adjustments to the live game.
Update27 Oct 2026
Launcher Update 2.2.0
New Launcher version: Required for the new client beta!
Update19 Oct 2026
📜Patch Notes - October 19, 2026
Small patch, bringing the Hallowtide spirit back as a few Festivals begin anew!
Marketplace12 Oct 2026
Marketplace Update | Oct 12, 2026
Halloween Spirit rolls around as the Marketplace update brings a ton of home decoration!
Update10 Oct 2026
📜Patch Notes - October 10, 2026
Cumulative fixes from September 30th to October 10th.
Update25 Sep 2026
📜 Patch Notes - September 25, 2026
Minor fixes in relation with 1.3.6
Update23 Sep 2026
Starfall: Discovery (1.3.6) | Patch Notes
Patch 1.3.6 is FINALLY out! Discover it all here.
Update28 Aug 2026
📜 Patch Notes - August 28, 2026
Small patch notes this week alongside the 1.3.6 Release Date announcement.
Marketplace21 Aug 2026
Marketplace Update | Aug 21, 2026
A few costumes are returning to the marketplace!
Update20 Aug 2026
📜 Patch Notes - August 20, 2026
🎙️ Voice Chat gets louder, clearer and easier to use! Plus Target Sign keybinds, an in-game ping display, performance improvements, Powerstone conversion, bug fixes, and an extra week of Anniversary events!
Update14 Aug 2026
📜 Patch Notes - August 14, 2026
Voice Chat Beta goes live and some other event changes are happening.
Announcement25 Oct 2026
Developer Blog: The Road to 2.0 & Beyond | Part 1
What's been happening behind the scenes at ArcheAge Classic? In this first developer blog, we take a look at our new game client, why we're rebuilding it, and how we plan to get it into players' hands
Announcement23 Sep 2026
Discord Unavailable
Our Discord is unavailable at the time, find the invite link below.
Announcement4 Sep 2026
Starfall: Discovery | Patch Preview
The newest installment in the Starfall Saga is landing soon in ArcheAge Classic. Starfall: Discovery will expand the story around the comet that has been looming over Erenor
Announcement30 Aug 2026
1.3.6 Preview - Enlightened Skills
Sixth post in our series of features on Discovery (1.3.6). Today's post presents Enlightened Skills.

1.3.6 Preview - Primal Anthalon

The second series on features of Discovery (1.3.6). Today's post presents the new Enlightened Ayanad accessories.
Announcement26 Jul 2026
ArcheAge Classic: Discovery (1.3.6) Trailer
The trailer for ArcheAge Classic's next major patch is out now! Watch it on our website, or on our YouTube channel.
Announcement9 Feb 2026
Video Showcase Event
Looking for a real sandbox MMO again? Welcome home. We’re hosting a and inviting both veterans to show what makes ArcheAge Classic special: freedom, risk, economy, PvP, naval chaos, and player-driven stories. :video heart: Submit here :pointright: https://discord.com/channels/1095780016945631325/1470434849927205117
